integrity: Exact analytic statement supported by a complete paper proof and independently executable rational-identity checks; external Bessel bounds and the spectral reduction are correctly attributed to literature.
scientific_limitations: The sufficient high-exponent threshold 27 is not claimed optimal. This concerns the planar radial-angular mixed norm, not the ordinary unmixed extension norm; no assertion for 4<q<27. Independent validation has not been carried out.
title: The first harmonic gives the sharp planar mixed-norm Fourier stability gap for every exponent \(q\ge27\)
